Overview:
This professional gardening pruning shear is made from imported Japanese SK5 steel, offering sharpness and durability for trimming fruit trees and flowers. The labor-saving design makes cutting thick branches easier, making it an ideal tool for home gardening and landscape maintenance.

Material: Imported Japanese SK5 Steel
Type: Pruning Shears / Gardening Scissors
Application: Fruit tree pruning, flower care, thick branch cutting
Features: Labor-saving design, sharp blade, various models available (including folding saws and sets)
